newsitem.title: USA: Mitsubishi, Pocket enter in $129 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi, Pocket enter in $129 mln deal.

text.p: Pocket Communications Inc said Monday it has entered into a handset agreement with Mitsubishi Wireless Communications Inc for personal communications systems wireless phones.

The potential value of the two-year contract,is about $129 million. As part of the strategic relationship between the two companies, Mitsubishi Corp, parent of Mitsubishi Wireless, has made an investment in Pocket.

A version of Mitsubishi's first Global System for a Mobile Communications phone will be made made available exclusively to Pocket, with delivery beginning in the third quarter. Pocket and Mitsubishi have been collaborating over the past year to create the handset.

Mitsubishi Wireless is a joint venture between Mitsubishi Electric Corp and Mitsubishi Corp. Pocket Communications is the nation's sixth largest PCS company (30 MHz licenses) with 43 Federal Communications Commission PCS licenses covering more than 35 million people.
